body.heading: Where in the world is Gabon?
paragraphs: Gabon is a country in Middle Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Gabon is Libreville.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Gabon is French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Gabon is the Central African CFA franc. The CFA franc is shared with neighbouring countries, so the same money works across the region.

body.heading: How big is Gabon?
paragraphs: Gabon covers about 268,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Kenya.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Loango is called 'Africa's Last Eden' — elephants and buffalo stroll on wild beaches, and hippos sometimes wade into the surf where forest meets the Atlantic.
In Lopé, rainforest rolls into savanna hills. It's one of the best places in Africa to track mandrills — the world's largest monkeys, with rainbow-coloured faces.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Gabon on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
